## Summary
Favorite opener style: the **clickbait opener** — a first message engineered purely to open a curiosity gap and force a reply. Examples (list truncated in the tweet preview; full set in the thread): "Can I be blunt?" / "You want honesty or—"

- Claimed **70–80% response rate** — *if your profile is already good*
- Easy to mass-send, zero overthinking
- Mechanism: curiosity → she replies → she has **invested** in the conversation

## Why it matters
- The mechanism (open loop → reply → sunk-cost investment) generalizes far beyond dating apps: cold outreach, DMs, email subject lines.
- Note the built-in caveat: the opener is capped by profile quality — fix the top of the funnel first; no opener rescues a bad profile.
